claims.statement: The general PPWR application date creates a real packaging-data transition across materials and origins.
The authoritative recyclability grades and associated fee modulation depend on future acts and later dates, so current outputs must be scenarios rather than definitive bills.
German reporting requires verifiable component material and weight data, supporting a supplier-evidence and BOM workflow.
A domestic German producer generally must file personally, so the product should stop at preparation, approval and export.
National fee rules remain materially differentiated, as shown by Dutch material and per-unit charges and Polish electronic reporting.
Low-priced direct competitors already bundle many proposed functions, narrowing the defensible wedge to change control, evidence provenance and supplier workflow.
No reviewed evidence validates converter distribution, customer conversion or savings from a prevented redesign.
No direct evidence establishes illegality, unobtainable essential rights, impossible conservative economics or non-delegable founder incompatibility.

contrary_evidence: Several decisive PPWR methods remain future acts, so an authoritative fee simulator is premature.
Published self-serve prices are substantially below enterprise-style assumptions for a generic tracker.
The obligated producer retains responsibility and, in Germany, generally performs the filing itself.
Free official portals already cover registration and submission, shifting value upstream to data governance.
